meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把创意、链接或设计稿变成带字幕动效的视频成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文字创意、网址或设计稿快速做成带动画的视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a brief, link, or design into a finished animated video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn ideas, links, or designs into animated videos.

howto.what: 收到视频、动画或动效需求时,它会先读取项目状态、必要时通过访谈写下 BRIEF.md 确认意图,再选定并安装对应工作流,用 HyperFrames 从 HTML 渲染出视频。已有项目也能做检查、预览、渲染、发布或批量渲染。
howto.when: 当你要求制作、编辑、动画或渲染视频、动效,或要检查、预览、发布已有的 HyperFrames 项目时触发。除非你明确指定其他框架或只要求录浏览器会话,输出默认用 HyperFrames。

howto.what_en: On any video, animation, or motion-graphic request it resumes project state, records intent in BRIEF.md when needed, selects and installs the owning workflow, then renders video from HTML. It can also inspect, preview, render, publish, or batch-render an existing project.
howto.when_en: Triggers on requests to make, edit, animate, or render video/motion graphics, or to inspect or publish an existing HyperFrames project. HyperFrames is the default framework unless you choose another.

say_en.text: Make a beat-synced video from this music track
Turn this GitHub PR into an explainer video
Check and preview my existing HyperFrames project
